scope: Exploratory validation-only statistical baseline; not a final test evaluation.

training_selection.reconstruction: Training seed and count; exact selected-index SHA-256 verified.

training_subset_source: Reference checkpoint's exact verified training subset, in physical units.

copula.marginals: All sorted training observations with linear inverse quantiles.
copula.dependence: Full normal-score sample correlation per condition, shrunk toward identity.
copula.regularization_selection: Fixed a priori; not tuned on validation targets.
copula.tail_policy: No extrapolation beyond each condition/feature's observed training range.
copula.constant_columns: Constant empirical inverse; zero latent cross-correlations and unit latent variance.

validation_selection.policy: Uniform without replacement within every observed condition; matches cli.evaluate_checkpoint.
validation_selection.index_hash_encoding: Zero-based row indices as little-endian int64 C-order bytes, in evaluation order.

frozen_samples.hash_encoding: Profiles: little-endian float64 C-order bytes; labels: little-endian int64 C-order bytes.
frozen_samples.postprocessing: Original-unit inverse empirical margins; no additional clipping or scaling.

interpretation: Fresh joint draws from a statistical comparator, not row resampling or evidence of GAN novelty. Linear empirical inverse quantiles smooth atoms; midrank Gaussian scores approximate tied/discrete margins. Compressed quantile knots can additionally distort sparse tails. Gaussian dependence cannot capture arbitrary joint multimodality or tail dependence, and empirical tails do not extrapolate. Metrics are descriptive validation diagnostics; nearest-neighbor checks provide no privacy guarantee. Repeated screening on validation precludes a confirmatory significance claim.
source_trace_independence: Original prepared split has detected exact full-year train/validation aliases. Exploratory diagnostics only; see docs/DUPLICATE_REMEDIATION.md. Numerical results preserved.
